text:
A vertically framed, painterly portrait shows a middle-aged woman from the chest up against a plain, textured gray-green background. She faces slightly to the viewer’s right while looking directly outward with warm brown eyes and a gentle, closed-mouth smile. Her lightly freckled, weathered face is softly lit from the upper left.

Her wavy dark-brown hair is loosely gathered into a high, untidy bun, with stray curls framing her face. Sprigs of greenery and clusters of tiny white flowers are woven into the hair on the left side of the image. She wears layered, rustic clothing in muted earth tones: a cream blouse, a dark bodice, a brown fringed shawl, and a thick moss-green wrap around her shoulders. A cord necklace holds a round metal pendant resembling a wheel or compass. Small bundles of herbs and a wrapped, bulb-shaped object are tucked into her clothing on the lower right. The overall style resembles a detailed historical oil painting.
